title: Lead Analyst
description:
Job Title:

Lead Analyst Intern– Speech Analytics

Department:

Etech Insights

Location:

Gandhinagar

Our team is growing – but we are not adding members just to fulfill requests. We are searching for individuals who are ready to be a part of the next big thing and are excited about growing with our company! Leadership is anxiously waiting to cultivate and develop your skills and prepare you for the career journey of a lifetime.

Our focus is to create lasting impressions with each customer interaction. Reflect on the times you have been the customer and you left your experience feeling satisfied, appreciated and valued. Simply put – these are the experiences you will use to deliver world class results to our customer base.

If you consider yourself to be a team player, goal oriented, and possess a passion for helping others; apply to become a part of the Etech Global Services Team.

About Us:

Globally, we are over 3000 strong, and we are always searching for new team members which will offer fresh and innovative ideas and diverse approaches to everyday problem solving. Etech is governed by 12-character commitments: Integrity, Valuing People, Teamwork, Accountability, Communication, Vision, Adaptability, Humility, Creativity, Teachability, Positive Influence, and Courage. Together, these 12 commitments guide our workplace culture and set the tone for how we treat each other.

Visit us: www.etechgs.com

**What We Offer:**

* Transportation allowance
* Canteen Subsidy
* Health Insurance
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Incentive components campaign wise
* Work Life Balance Initiatives
* Rewards & Recognition
* Internal movement through IJP

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

· Will initiate launching of audit process for new campaigns as assigned by Project Leader/Account Leader

· Will interact with Operations to ensure that the expectations in terms of QA support to the campaigns are met

· Understand the SLA of the campaigns in the terms of QA support and ensure that those are met.

· Design Audit Forms, get it approved by Ops and Client and place it online in QEval

· Initiate MI/BI studies as and when required

· Take initiatives for process improvement

· Will possess overall knowledge of all the campaigns audited by EI

· Periodically monitor utilization, audit accuracy etc of the QA team

· Help in setting up calibrations and provide all assistance to QA Lead Interns/Asst. QA Leads in maintaining a smooth calibration process

· Maintain minimum 95% schedule adherence of self and the team

· Will act as role model for Leaders and Team Members of internal and external departments

· Must be accessible, available and flexible with shift timings

· Have an open attitude and avoid discounting, dismissing, or minimizing questions

· Maintain personal and professional boundaries, but avoid being distant or unapproachable

· Always lead by example

· Adhere to the policies and procedures of Etech

· Provide excellence when communicating with customers (internal and external)

· Be flexible in an environment by championing and embracing change

· Create a spirit of mutual learning, trust and respect

**We expect you to have:**

· Graduate or equivalent experience in BPO call monitoring and auditing

· Must have minimum 2-3 experience in speech analytics

· Good technical knowledge needed. Should be aware about API, Metadata, Queries, Python language etc

· Must have worked as a leader

· Should be well versed with PPT and Advanced excel.

· Interpersonal skills & ability to influence

· Excellent written & verbal Communication skills including client interactions

· Planning and organisational skills

· Well organised and structure approach to work Ability to work to deadlines and targets  
Leadership experience is mandatory for this role  
**Interested in this opportunity?**  
**Please feel free to connect with me for more details. Ekta.Darda@etechgs.com**  
**8866957331**

Pay: ₹35,000.00 - ₹65,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

title: QA Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced **QA Engineer** with strong hands-on experience in **Manual and Automation Testing**. The ideal candidate should have experience testing web applications, mobile applications, APIs, and backend systems.

Responsibilities

* Understand requirements and prepare test cases and scenarios.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing.
* Design, develop, and maintain **automated test scripts**.
* Perform **API testing** using Postman or similar tools.
* Test web and mobile applications across different platforms and devices.
* Perform database validation and backend testing.
* Identify, document, and track bugs through resolution.
* Collaborate with developers to troubleshoot issues and verify fixes.
* Improve test coverage, automation, and overall QA processes.

Skills & Requirements

* **1+ years of experience in Software Testing / QA.**
* Strong experience in **Manual & Automation Testing**.
* Hands-on experience with **Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Appium**, or similar automation frameworks.
* Strong knowledge of **API Testing** and REST APIs.
* Experience with **Web & Mobile Application Testing**.
* Knowledge of **SQL/MSSQL, MongoDB**, or similar databases.
* Performance testing experience with **JMeter** or similar tools is a plus.
* Good understanding of QA methodologies and the software development lifecycle.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to take ownership of product quality and work independently.

**How to Apply:**  
Send your resume to **career@praeclarumtech.com**

Apply online:  
**https://app.praeclarumtech.com/talent/applicants/applyNow**

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

title: Junior QA Engineer
description:
We are looking for a QA Engineer with 1–2 years of experience in both Manual and Automation Testing.

The candidate should be able to understand requirements, prepare test scenarios, identify bugs effectively, and contribute towards automation testing for web and mobile applications.The ideal candidate should have good analytical skills, attention to detail, and understanding of software testing processes.

**Responsibilities**

* Understand project requirements and functional specifications
* Prepare and execute test cases, test scenarios, and test reports
* Perform Manual Testing for web and mobile applications
* Identify, report, track, and verify bugs/issues
* Perform Regression, Smoke, Functional, and UI Testing
* Collaborate with developers, project managers, and business teams
* Create and maintain automation test scripts

* Ensure product quality before production releases
* Validate APIs and backend responses where required

* Good understanding of SDLC and STLC

* Postman

**Good to Have**

* Ability to find practical bugs
* Test case writing quality
* Real\-world testing approach

* Analytical thinking

title: Senior Data Quality Assurance Specialist
description:
Position Overview The Senior Data Quality Assurance (QA) Specialist is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reliability of enterprise data assets, reporting solutions, and data integration processes.

This role serves as the primary quality assurance resource for Power BI reporting, SQL\-based data warehouses, ETL processes, and data integrations from internal and third\-party systems.

The Senior Data QA Specialist will perform comprehensive validation of data pipelines, reports, dashboards, and database objects while proactively identifying and resolving data discrepancies across multiple systems.

The position works closely with Data Engineers, BI Developers, Business Analysts, and business stakeholders to ensure data integrity throughout the data lifecycle.

Additionally, this role supports production operations through troubleshooting, root cause analysis, defect management, and resolution of data\-related issues impacting business reporting and analytics.

This position will report to the Director — Enterprise Data and BI.

Pay: ₹1,000,000\.00 \- ₹15,000,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time

title: QA Engineer - CRM
description:
We are looking for a **QA Engineer** with strong experience in **CRM application testing, CRM workflows/blueprints, and load/performance testing**.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Test CRM applications and end\-to\-end business processes.
* Understand and test **CRM Blueprints, Workflows, Automations, Business Rules, and Approvals**.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Perform **load, stress, performance, and scalability testing**.
* Strong experience testing **high concurrent users, API load, response time, and system performance**.
* Experience with **load balancing, distributed environments, and performance bottleneck identification**.
* Perform **API testing** using Postman or similar tools.
* Perform **SQL/database validation and data reconciliation**.
* Test CRM integrations with third\-party applications and APIs.
* Create test cases, test scenarios, and defect reports.
* Work closely with developers, business analysts, product teams, and clients.
* Participate in Agile/Scrum activities.

**Mandatory Skills**

* **3\+ years QA experience**
* Strong **CRM testing experience**
* Good understanding of **CRM Blueprints \& Workflows**
* Strong **Load \& Performance Testing** experience
* Good understanding of **Load Balancing \& Scalability**
* API Testing
* SQL/Database Testing
* Functional, Regression \& Integration Testing
* Jira or similar defect management tools
* Strong analytical and **communication skills**

**Preferred**

* Experience with **Zoho CRM, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, HubSpot**, or similar CRM platforms.
* Experience with **JMeter, LoadRunner, k6, Selenium, Playwright, or Cypress**.
* Experience with cloud\-based CRM applications and integrations.

title: Project Coordinator
description:
**IMPORTANT: Applications are accepted ONLY via our official website**

**Apply here: https://www.technource.com/jobs/junior\-project\-coordinator/**

Technource is looking for a **Junior Project Coordinator** who is interested in building a career in software project coordination and delivery. The role involves working closely with Project Managers, Business Analysts, Developers, QA teams, and other stakeholders to support smooth project execution, task tracking, requirement coordination, and timely communication. This is an ideal opportunity for someone with good communication, organization, and problem\-solving skills who wants to grow into project management within an IT services environment.

**Key Responsibilities \& Requirements:**

* Basic understanding of the **software development lifecycle, web/mobile application projects, and Agile/Scrum methodologies**.
* Assist Project Managers and senior team members with **task tracking, team follow\-ups, requirement coordination, project updates, and ensuring activities move as planned**.
* Coordinate with **Developers, QA, Business Analysts, Designers, and other project team members** to track dependencies, pending discussions, and project progress.
* Ability to understand basic client/business requirements and help maintain proper **project documentation, task updates, meeting notes, and follow\-up records**.
* Familiarity with project management and communication tools such as **Jira, Trello, Slack, or similar platforms** is an added advantage.
* Basic understanding of technology stacks such as **Laravel, Node.js, React.js, mobile technologies, or other software development technologies** will be preferred.
* Good **English communication and presentation skills**, attention to detail, strong follow\-up ability, and willingness to learn client communication and project management under guidance.
